# The status-check contexts the `main` branch ruleset REQUIRES.
#
# A required context must never be skippable: a SKIPPED job reports as a
# PASSING required check, and a `continue-on-error` job reports a FAILING run
# as a passing one. Keep every job named here free of a job-level `if:`, a
# `needs:`, and `continue-on-error`, and change this list together with the
# live ruleset.
#
# One context per line. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. These names
# are GitHub Actions JOB IDS; none of these jobs sets a `name:` override.
check
frontend
review-gate
typecheck
vuln-scan
